name: Valparaiso University
academic_ranking: Private Lutheran national university. 2025 U.S. News: tied #204 among National Universities, #45 Best Value Schools, and tied #15 in Best Undergraduate Engineering Programs (institutions without doctorate). Organized into five undergraduate colleges (Arts & Sciences, Business, Engineering, Nursing & Health Professions, and Christ College honors college) with 70+ programs. ~89% acceptance rate (2025).
financial_aid: Approximately 94% of undergraduates receive financial assistance. Aid includes merit and need-based scholarships, grants, federal and private loans, and student employment. 2026-27 undergraduate tuition is $50,650 (12-19 credits/semester) plus a $1,630 general fee ($52,280 tuition and fees). Net Price Calculator available at valpo.edu/aid.
facilities_notes: Softball competes at the on-campus Valparaiso softball complex. Specific facility details not confirmed from live source during research 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division I program competing in the Missouri Valley Conference. Note: the university has faced recent enrollment declines and financial challenges in recent years.
notes: Researched 2026-07 from live pages. Coaching staff, roster size (23), and 2026-27 tuition confirmed from official sources. Scholarship count not publicly listed. Team X account: @ValpoSoftball. No individual coach phone numbers or personal Twitter/X handles listed in the staff directory.
